user.title: Set up Puppy Tracker
user.description: Set up Puppy Tracker to register and monitor puppy weights.

manage_litter.title: Manage litter
manage_litter.description: Select the litter you want to manage.

edit_litter.title: Edit litter
edit_litter.description: Edit litter details, archive or restore the litter, or permanently delete it.

data.name: Name
data.growth_milestones_percent: Growth milestones (% of birth weight, comma-separated)

data_description.name: Name of the litter
data_description.breed_profile: Descriptive breed profile used for future growth analysis. It does not apply a breed-specific diagnosis or curve.
data_description.size_class: Optional size class for future growth analysis.
data_description.min_daily_growth_percent: Leave empty to use the integration monitoring setting.
data_description.max_hours_between_weighings: Leave empty to use the integration monitoring setting.
data_description.growth_monitoring_days: Leave empty to use the integration monitoring setting.
data_description.first_day_max_weight_loss_percent: Leave empty to use the current general day-one limit.
data_description.expected_adult_weight_min_grams: Optional parent/breeder-based estimate; leave empty when unknown.
data_description.expected_adult_weight_max_grams: Optional parent/breeder-based estimate; leave empty when unknown.
data_description.growth_milestones_percent: For example 200, 400 for 2x and 4x birth weight. Leave empty for 200, 400.
data_description.action: Choose what you want to do with this litter

confirm_delete_litter.description: You are about to permanently delete {name}. This litter contains {puppies} puppies and {measurements} stored measurements. This cannot be undone.

add_puppy.description: Add a puppy to an existing litter.

data_description.birth_weight: Weight immediately after birth in grams
data_description.birth_time: Exact date and time of birth if known
data_description.profile_note: Long-lived profile summary. New chronological notes will be stored separately in the puppy dossier.

manage_puppy.title: Manage puppy
manage_puppy.description: Select the puppy you want to manage.

edit_puppy.title: Edit puppy
edit_puppy.description: Edit puppy details, archive or restore the puppy, or permanently delete it.

data_description.name: Name or identification name of the puppy
data_description.birth_time: Exact date and time of birth
data_description.action: Choose what you want to do with this puppy
data_description.profile_note: Long-lived profile summary. New chronological notes will be stored separately in the puppy dossier.

settings.title: Monitoring settings
settings.description: Configure the weight and growth thresholds used by Puppy Tracker. Notification delivery is managed separately under Notifications.

data_description.min_daily_growth_percent: Flag normalized daily growth below this percentage.
data_description.max_hours_between_weighings: Flag a puppy when no new weight has been recorded within this number of hours.
data_description.growth_monitoring_days: After this age the minimum daily growth threshold is no longer applied. Weight loss can still be flagged.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Manage all Puppy Tracker notification delivery settings in one place.

notification_preferences.title: Notification preferences
notification_preferences.description: Choose which Puppy Tracker events may send notifications and which notify entities should receive push messages.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Create Home Assistant notifications when an active puppy enters an attention state.
data_description.recurring_reminder_notifications_enabled: Automatically notify when a recurring reminder becomes due soon or overdue.
data_description.notification_lead_minutes: Fallback time in minutes before a scheduled reminder. Used when a care program or recurring reminder leaves its own value empty.
data_description.notify_recovery: Send a one-time recovery message when a puppy returns to normal.
data_description.notify_session_complete: Send one notification after a weighing session is fully completed.
data_description.notify_entities: Optional notify entities, for example your phone. Persistent Home Assistant notifications are still used where supported.

test_notification.title: Send test notification
test_notification.description: Send a real Puppy Tracker test notification now. It will also be sent to the {targets} configured push target(s). This does not change any reminder, due date or completion state.

manage_measurements.title: Manage measurements
manage_measurements.description: Select the puppy whose stored weighings you want to inspect or manage.

select_measurement.title: Select measurement
select_measurement.description: {puppy} has {count} stored measurement records. 🗑 means deleted and ↪ means superseded by a correction.

edit_measurement.title: Manage measurement
edit_measurement.description: {puppy}: {measurement}. A correction never overwrites the old record; the original remains stored as history.

data_description.timestamp: Date and time when this weighing was performed.
data_description.reason: Optional explanation stored in the audit log.
data_description.action: Correct, delete, or restore this measurement.

confirm_delete_measurement.title: Delete measurement
confirm_delete_measurement.description: You are about to delete this measurement for {puppy}: {measurement}. The measurement is only soft-deleted and remains stored in history. If this is the birth-weight measurement, the puppy birth-weight field is cleared as well.

integrity.title: Data integrity check
integrity.description: Storage check complete. Status: {status}. Checked {measurements} measurement versions. Found {issues} issue(s), safely repaired {repairs}. Unresolved critical issues: {critical}; warnings: {warnings}. Safe repairs never choose between ambiguous measurement branches. Download integration diagnostics when unresolved critical issues remain.

error.notification_test_failed: The test notification could not be sent. Check the configured notify entities and Home Assistant notification services.
error.invalid_measurement: The selected measurement no longer exists or cannot be changed in its current state.
